description: tree() runs `cargo tree` through spawn_with_deadline(&mut cargo, None), which applies the shared 60 s SUBPROCESS_DEADLINE. The command has no --locked and no --offline, so it may touch the network to refresh the registry index and may wait on Cargo's package-cache or build-directory lock while a concurrent cargo process (for example the outer `cargo test --workspace`) holds it. On a cold or contended CI host the call can exceed 60 s and the runner kills it, so the test fails on some runs and passes on others depending on cache state and network speed. The test calls tree() 7 times (1 control, 1 workspace, 5 inverted queries), so it has 7 independent exposures to this window. The sprint already documents the same class of problem for builds: bin_path.rs gives cold release builds a 20 min deadline with a comment about 'Blocking waiting for file lock'. The cargo tree calls get no such treatment.
